data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘fattah’ meaning ‘opener’ or ‘victorious’. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the one who opens the way to success and triumphs over challenges. The name Fattumah carries the meaning “Victorious one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fattumah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
